kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أجتهد (form VIII)
# أَجْتَهِدُ (ʔajtahidu) /ʔad͡ʒ.ta.hi.du/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِجْتَهَدَ (ijtahada)
# أَجْتَهِدَ (ʔajtahida) /ʔad͡ʒ.ta.hi.da/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِجْتَهَدَ (ijtahada)
# أَجْتَهِدْ (ʔajtahid) /ʔad͡ʒ.ta.hid/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِجْتَهَدَ (ijtahada)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
